environment: LinkeDOM + Node VM + controlled IntersectionObserver and RPC promises; synthetic articles only.

checks.name: first request explicitly asks the existing RPC for 100 rows
concurrent sentinel callbacks do not duplicate the pending page
final partial page stops automatic fetching and displays completion
failed append preserves existing tags and stops automatic retries
manual retry resumes the failed offset without clearing loaded tags
search reset ignores an earlier pending response and resets offset
sentinel cannot fetch background pages while the reading view is open
an exact multiple performs one empty end check then stops
